Speech for the replay tests, 16 kHz mono WAV.

- `jfk.wav`: John F. Kennedy's 1961 inaugural address, 11 s (US government work, public domain).
- `1272-128104-*.wav`: LibriSpeech dev-clean (CC BY 4.0, Panayotov et al., openslr.org/12), via
  `hf-internal-testing/librispeech_asr_dummy`. Reference text in `librispeech.json`.
  `-0004` is 29.4 s, longer than the bot's 25 s utterance cap.
